notes.title: Unleashing iDentity Rebels: A Livestream Showcase of Current & Future Features
notes.content:
Join us for an exciting livestream event showcasing "Identity Rebels," an innovative and captivating game currently in development. As part of the Steam Next Festival, we invite you to be part of an exclusive demo experience where you can witness the game's potential and immerse yourself in its unique world.

During the livestream, you will have the opportunity to watch our game developer in action as they navigate the immersive gameplay of "Identity Rebels." Dive deep into the game's mechanics, explore its stunning environments, and witness its engaging storyline unfold before your eyes.

But that's not all! This livestream event goes beyond just gameplay. As you enjoy the demo, our developer will be there to answer your questions, provide insights into the game's development process, and discuss exciting future features planned for "Identity Rebels." Get an exclusive glimpse into the game's upcoming updates, expansions, and the vision behind its creation.

Whether you're a fan of immersive storytelling, strategic gameplay, or simply enjoy being at the forefront of innovative gaming experiences, this livestream event is not to be missed. Mark your calendars and prepare to be captivated by the world of "Identity Rebels" as it takes shape in this special demo session.

Don't forget to bring your curiosity and join us live for an unforgettable journey into the heart of "Identity Rebels." See you there!

notes.title: Unleashing iDentity Rebels (Day 2): The Roadmap to Adventure
notes.content:
Welcome back to my thrilling second livestream event, building upon the success of our first showcase of "Identity Rebels"! As a solo developer I’ve had to take on everything from concept art to code.  So I’m truly honored to be here & glad that you’ve decided to watch my stream. Today I will delve deeper into the captivating world of this upcoming game, presented as part of the Steam Next Festival.

During this special session, I’ll continue my exploration of "Identity Rebels" with an even more focused lens on the roadmap ahead. Dive into the intricate details of the game's future features, expanded gameplay mechanics, and the exciting adventures that await players.

In this livestream event, I will be your guide taking you on a journey through the envisioned future of "Identity Rebels." Discover the upcoming storylines, immersive environments, and the unique characters you'll encounter along the way.

But this event is not just about me talking at you. I want your input! Join me for an interactive Q&A session where you can ask your burning questions, share your thoughts, and provide valuable feedback that will shape the development of "Identity Rebels."

Together, let's chart the course for an epic adventure as I delve into the roadmap of "Identity Rebels." This livestream event is a golden opportunity to be part of the game's evolution and to witness firsthand the exciting potential that lies ahead.
